message.content:
Since \(5^2+12^2=13^2\), \(\triangle ABC\) is right at \(C\), so

\[
[ABC]=\frac12(5)(12)=30.
\]

Now \(CM=4\), so \(AM=AC-CM=5-4=1\). Also \(CN=4\), so \(BN=BC-CN=12-4=8\).

Because \(MJ\perp AB\), \(\triangle AMJ\) is similar to \(\triangle ABC\). The hypotenuse \(AM\) corresponds to \(AB\), so the scale factor is

\[
\frac{AM}{AB}=\frac{1}{13}.
\]

Thus

\[
[AMJ]=\left(\frac{1}{13}\right)^2[ABC]=\frac{30}{169}.
\]

Similarly, \(\triangle BNK\sim \triangle ABC\), with hypotenuse \(BN\) corresponding to \(AB\). Thus the scale factor is

\[
\frac{BN}{AB}=\frac{8}{13},
\]

so

\[
[BNK]=\left(\frac{8}{13}\right)^2[ABC]=\frac{64}{169}\cdot 30=\frac{1920}{169}.
\]

Pentagon \(CMJKN\) is \(\triangle ABC\) with \(\triangle AMJ\) and \(\triangle BNK\) removed:

\[
[CMJKN]=30-\frac{30}{169}-\frac{1920}{169}
=\frac{5070-30-1920}{169}
=\frac{3120}{169}
=\frac{240}{13}.
\]

The answer is \(\frac{240}{13}\).
